## User Story Statement

**I want** [a concrete capability or system interaction],  
**So that** [a measurable user outcome or environmental benefit].

## Non-Functional Requirements & HCI Constraints
- **Latency / Performance**: e.g., On-device inference < 150ms.
- **Accessibility**: e.g., High-contrast indicator, large text support, TTS Vietnamese voice readout.
- **Offline Reliability**: e.g., Functions without active cellular/Wi-Fi connection.
